author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Warmachine MkIV under Steamforged Games has a new Core Book out in retailers now. Aimed at being useful for a whole spectrum of experience levels it's both a core-rules reference and an introduction to the current state of the Iron Kingdoms and the factions that do battle there. Let's check it out!

Grab the rules and App for free HERE: https://steamforged.com/collections/warmachine

Thanks to SFG for the complimentary copy of the book to review.
